title: Create unit test runner and parameter tests
description:
Create tests/TestMain.cpp and tests/ParameterTests.cpp, and modify CMakeLists.txt ONLY. This is the phase's final serialized CMakeLists.txt write.

Before editing, inspect:
- CMakeLists.txt as left by task b.6 (ShredSpace target and target_sources block)
- Source/Parameters/ParameterIDs.h, ParameterLayout.h, ParameterSnapshot.h
- Source/PluginProcessor.h (getValueTreeState, getStateInformation, setStateInformation)

TESTING FRAMEWORK: juce::UnitTest ONLY. Catch2, GoogleTest, doctest, and every other third-party test framework are forbidden; no new third-party dependency of any kind may be added.

1. tests/TestMain.cpp: a console main() that constructs a juce::UnitTestRunner, sets setAssertOnFailure(false), runs all registered tests, iterates the results, prints failures, and returns a non-zero exit code if any test failed. Initialize and shut down JUCE appropriately for a console app (juce::ScopedJuceInitialiser_GUI or equivalent).

2. tests/ParameterTests.cpp: a juce::UnitTest subclass (static instance, category "ShredSpace/Parameters") that builds the layout via shredspace::createParameterLayout() inside a juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState attached to a test AudioProcessor (or by instantiating the plugin processor directly) and asserts:
   a. EXISTENCE: every ID constant declared in Source/Parameters/ParameterIDs.h resolves to a parameter in the layout (apvts.getParameter(id) != nullptr). Enumerate the IDs explicitly in a local array; do not skip any group.
   b. RANGES AND DEFAULTS: for a representative but broad set covering all eight groups, assert the parameter's NormalisableRange start/end and its default value equal the values frozen in tasks b.2, b.3, and b.4. Cover at minimum: GLOBAL_INPUT_GAIN (-24/+24, default 0), GLOBAL_MIX (0/100, default 22), GLOBAL_BYPASS_MODE default index 1, PERF_MACRO_TIME (20/2000, default 380), PERF_MACRO_TAIL (0.15/12, default 2.8), PERF_ADAPTIVE_MODE default index 2, TIME_SYNC_DIVISION with 15 choices and default index 6, STEREO_LF_MONO_FREQ (60/500, default 180), SCENE_MORPH (0/100, default 0), VOICE_A_LEVEL default -12 and VOICE_B_LEVEL default -10, VOICE_A_TIME_RATIO default 0.5 and VOICE_B_TIME_RATIO default 1.0, VOICE_A_WIDTH default 60 and VOICE_B_WIDTH default 130, VOICE_A_LPF default 6500 and VOICE_B_LPF default 5500, INTEL_SENSITIVITY (0/100, default 55), INTEL_INPUT_GATE (-80/-20, default -55), INTEL_WET_REDUCTION (0/18, default 8), INTEL_BLOOM_RELEASE (50/3000, default 800), INTEL_TRANSIENT_CROSSOVER (1000/6000, default 2500). Compare floats with an explicit tolerance.
   c. INTERNAL STATE ABSENCE: assert that no parameter ID in the layout contains any of these substrings (case-insensitive): "RUNNING_MEAN", "DEVIATION", "FFT", "ONSET", "HISTORY", "ACTIVITY", "DENSITY_VALUE", "SUSTAIN_VALUE", "PHRASE_GAP_VALUE", "DESTINATION_TABLE", "SCENE_NAME", "PROFILE_NAME", "PROFILE_DESC", "PROFILE_TAG", "MIGRATION", "TELEMETRY", "INTERVENTION", "BUFFER", "RESAMPLER". Enumerate the full parameter list from the APVTS to run this check.
   d. STATE ROUND-TRIP: instantiate the ShredSpace processor, change several parameters away from their defaults across different groups, call getStateInformation into a juce::MemoryBlock, construct a second processor instance, call setStateInformation on it with that block, and assert every parameter's normalized value in the second instance equals the first instance's within tolerance. Also assert that calling setStateInformation with an empty or corrupt MemoryBlock leaves the second processor's parameters at their previous values.

3. CMakeLists.txt: add a console executable target named ShredSpaceTests built from tests/TestMain.cpp, tests/ParameterTests.cpp, Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp, Source/Parameters/ParameterSnapshot.cpp, and the processor sources needed for the round-trip test. Link the required JUCE modules through juce_add_console_app or add_executable plus target_link_libraries with the same JUCE module set the plugin uses. Enable testing with enable_testing() and register the target with add_test(NAME ShredSpaceTests COMMAND ShredSpaceTests). Do not create new plugin targets, do not change the project identity, do not change the JUCE submodule pin, and do not remove or reorder existing ShredSpace target configuration.

Per this phase's risk notes, this task's own verification is compile-only: build the test target but do not run ctest here; ctest execution belongs to phase verification. No artist or song names in any file.
acceptance_criteria: tests/TestMain.cpp defines a console main() that runs juce::UnitTestRunner over all registered tests and returns non-zero on any failure
tests/ParameterTests.cpp defines a juce::UnitTest subclass asserting ID existence, ranges and defaults, internal-state name absence, and get/setStateInformation round-trip equality
tests/ParameterTests.cpp and tests/TestMain.cpp use only juce::UnitTest and include no Catch2, GoogleTest, doctest, or other third-party test framework
CMakeLists.txt defines a ShredSpaceTests console executable and registers it via enable_testing() and add_test(NAME ShredSpaceTests COMMAND ShredSpaceTests)
CMakeLists.txt still builds the ShredSpace VST3, LV2, and Standalone targets with the unchanged project identity and JUCE submodule pin
No file outside tests/TestMain.cpp, tests/ParameterTests.cpp, and CMakeLists.txt is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/Parameters/ParameterIDs.h, ParameterLayout.h, ParameterLayout.cpp, ParameterSnapshot.h, or ParameterSnapshot.cpp
modify anything under JUCE/ or change the JUCE submodule pin
add Catch2, GoogleTest, doctest, or any other third-party dependency
change the plugin name, vendor, version, manufacturer code, plugin code, bundle identifier, or LV2 URI
remove or reorder existing ShredSpace target configuration in CMakeLists.txt
weaken or delete an assertion to make a test pass

allowed: choose juce_add_console_app or add_executable for the test target
choose the float comparison tolerance used in assertions
choose whether the round-trip test uses the plugin processor directly or a minimal test processor for layout-only checks
forbidden: add a test helper library target
change the parameter layout to make an assertion pass
